svg.text: RetinaNeXt: ConvNeXt-Tiny backbone, BiFPN neck and CBAM attention on a RetinaNet head
Block height encodes spatial resolution; block width encodes channel count. Spatial sizes are for a 640 x 640 input.
35.20 M parameters, 26.1 FPS, 9 foreground classes, 9 anchors per location
Anchor sizes per level: 32/40/50, 64/80/101, 128/161/203, 256/322/406, 512/645/812 at ratios 0.5, 1.0 and 2.0. Sigmoid focal loss, alpha = 0.25, gamma = 2.0.
Repeated three times. Fusion spans P3-P5 only.
Each edge carries a learnable weight, normalised as w = relu(w) + 1e-4 divided by the sum.
C. CBAM, applied at every level
Channel attention first, then spatial attention. 0.041 M parameters total.
Both gates multiply the feature map element-wise. Channel reduction ratio is 16, so 256 - 16 - 256.
Applied after the neck, to all five levels P3-P7. The backbone is never touched by CBAM.
Costs 0.12 pp of mAP@0.5 in-domain but is retained for its cross-domain contribution.
